name: fgets
expr: fname = tempname; fid = fopen(fname, 'w'); fprintf(fid, 'hello\n'); fclose(fid); fid = fopen(fname, 'r'); line = fgets(fid); fclose(fid); delete(fname); r1 = double(strlength(line) >= 5);
comment: Side-effect smoke test (file I/O round-trip in single snippet via tempname). fgets reads one line WITH newline -- length >= 5 ('hello\n').
